title: Add the Node.js/Express gallery example
description:
**Goal**: Build the gallery's Node.js/Express example here in staging, perfect it, then copy it to connect-extensions to close posit-dev/connect-extensions#374. 

**Concept**: `Express: Real-Time Transaction Monitor` — an Express app that streams a live feed of bank payments/transactions to the browser via Server-Sent Events, with fraud/anomaly flags and running totals (volume, throughput, flagged count). Data is simulated server-side so it works on install with no external source; the "adapt it" lesson is to point it at a real stream (a queue, DB change feed, or webhook). Highlights the unique benefits of Node.js in Connect and covers the Banking industry theme.

**Sequencing**: This work depends on #36 (the node-capable integration harness) being merged. Once it is perfected + green in staging (publishes to the staging feed / dogfood), we can copy it to connect-extensions as the PR that closes #374.

title: Adopt connect-extensions' with-connect integration harness (with Node.js support)
description:
When working on #34, I discovered that the integration tests are old compared to those in `connect-extensions`.

`connect-extensions` has:
1. moved its integration tests to [with-connect](https://github.com/posit-dev/with-connect), which resolves the correct Connect image per version automatically (PR #355: https://github.com/posit-dev/connect-extensions/pull/355)
2. added Node.js support to that harness (PR #423: https://github.com/posit-dev/connect-extensions/pull/423)

Here, we'll update the testing to match `connect-extensions`: copy the harness (the `connect-integration-tests.yml` workflow, the `connect-integration-test` action, and `integration/Makefile`) and drop the old `compose.yaml` / `Dockerfile`.

We'll also make any other changes as needed to support the expected workflow for `connect-staging-extensions`: this is the place where you add a new example/extension you are working on, and the testing only checks to make sure that specific example/extension is working. Once it's finished, it moves to `connect-extensions` to be publicly released to the Gallery.

Note that this repo does not need the weekly scheduled integration-test workflow that `connect-extensions` has.

title: Carry imgUrl through the gallery generator (allows thumbnails to render)
description:
In `connect-extensions`, we added functionality so that you could have thumbnails for each example/extension: https://github.com/posit-dev/connect-extensions/pull/389

We should also add this functionality to `connect-staging-extensions` so that any new examples/extensions in development can also render thumbnails.
